label: composition-1
name: CallElimCorrect.extractedOldExprInVars
source:
open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  intros Hnorm
  induction post <;>
    simp only [extractOldExprVars, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.Subset.empty]
  case app fn e fn_ih e_ih =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split
    . intros x Hin
      assumption
    . next Hfalse =>
      cases Hnorm with
      | app H1 H2 Hn =>
      exfalso
      specialize Hn _
      constructor
      cases Hn
      apply Hfalse
      rfl
    . cases Hnorm with
      | app H1 H2 Hn =>
      apply List.Subset.app
      . apply List.subset_append_of_subset_left
        apply fn_ih
        assumption
      . apply List.subset_append_of_subset_right
        apply e_ih
        assumption
  case abs ih =>
    cases Hnorm
    apply ih ; assumption
  case quant trih eih =>
    cases Hnorm
    apply List.Subset.app
    . apply List.subset_append_of_subset_left
      apply trih ; assumption
    . apply List.subset_append_of_subset_right
      apply eih ; assumption
  case ite cih tih eih =>
    cases Hnorm
    apply List.Subset.app
    . apply List.subset_append_of_subset_left
      apply List.Subset.app
      . apply List.subset_append_of_subset_left
        apply cih ; assumption
      . apply List.subset_append_of_subset_right
        apply tih ; assumption
    apply List.subset_append_of_subset_right
    apply eih ; assumption
  case eq ih1 ih2 =>
    cases Hnorm
    apply List.Subset.app
    . apply List.subset_append_of_subset_left
      apply ih1 ; assumption
    . apply List.subset_append_of_subset_right
      apply ih2 ; assumption
